text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro McQueen has been pretty tired
lately, so I
decide to bring her to the
infirmary to get some
rest.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
G-good grief... You don't have to look
after me
like I'm a child.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Besides, I won't be able to fall asleep
with you
hovering over me like so.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Surely you're exhausted too. Please, go
to your
own room and get some rest. Go
on, now!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Hm? What's this? ...Perhaps I'm having a
dream.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Is that... a plushie over there? It
seems
familiar, somehow...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Ah! It's Usarina! Grandmother gave her
to me a
long time ago!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Ahh, this brings back such fond
memories...
Whenever I was sick, I'd
snuggle up with her in
bed.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
The day that I moved and had to say
goodbye, I
cried all night.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
But I've grown since then. I'm no longer
a
crybaby, neither am I so sickly.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
And... the dreams I had back then have
become
my determination.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
My determination to achieve perfect
victory as a
member of the Mejiro family!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hearing Mejiro McQueen's words,
Usarina almost
seems to be smiling.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In that instant, a dazzling light fills the
entire
area.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
A perfect dream and a perfect
awakening. I feel
as though strength is
surging through me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With her energy restored, Mejiro
McQueen leaves
the infirmary with a
spring in her step.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro McQueen's words don't seem to
reach
Usarina, who simply sits there
motionless.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Oh... I-I'm sorry. All I've done is talk
about
myself... Um, uh... Well...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As she's trying to think of what to say, a
dazzling
light fills the entire area...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Ah... Is this the infirmary?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: So, that means it really was all a dream.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Sigh... It was a rather sad one.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Unable to take her mind off the dream,
Mejiro
McQueen fails to get an
adequate amount of rest.
